purpose: Validate the causal, interval-based synthetic input contract before opening a new estimator hypothesis.

measurement_contract.delta_angle: integral of body angular rate over (t[i-1], t[i]]; row zero is zero
measurement_contract.delta_velocity: integral of body specific force over (t[i-1], t[i]]; row zero is zero
measurement_contract.public_api_boundary: The current public ESKF still consumes SI rate/specific-force samples; delta fields audit the private adapter contract.

stationarity.known_limit: IMU-only stationarity cannot distinguish rest from constant-velocity translation; FCOne must add private armed/vehicle-state policy.

noise.definition: continuous white-noise density; per-sample standard deviation is density times sqrt(rate_hz)

deferred: bias random walk and thermal drift
causal fixed-lag estimator correction and protected holdout
